name: print-social-dia-afrocolombianidad-story-black-with-bauhaus-tile-collage
title: 'Día de la Afrocolombianidad' story with a black portrait and a colourful Bauhaus icon-tile collage
whatItIs: A black vertical story with orange, red and blue condensed type ('DÍA DE LA — AFRO — COLOMBIANIDAD'), a date and time line, a black-and-white portrait of a man with his hand to his face, overlaid by a grid of small colourful geometric icon tiles (leaves, arrows, triangles, a maze pattern) in orange, red and blue.
whatItMeans: Respectful and vibrant; overlaying cultural pattern tiles onto a portrait ties heritage motifs directly to a real person.
techniques: Overlay a grid of small pattern tiles onto a portrait photo.
Use a shared colour palette across dozens of small icon tiles.
Keep the headline in bold condensed caps with colour-split lines.

vocabulary.definition: A grid of small repeating pattern or icon squares.
A visual pattern carrying specific cultural meaning.
